_comment: Live stock pulled from the Shopify Admin API on 2026-09-08. Refresh with The Chemist. Note that BUNDLES carry their own inventory number that is independent of component stock, which is exactly why the make list has to be exploded through the bill of materials in state/bom.json.
coverage: First 20 active products by id. There are more pages, so treat missing items as unknown rather than zero.

buffers._comment: Minimum units to hold. Below this the make list flags it. Set from what actually sells, top sellers get deeper buffers.
